question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined phrase.

I should __look into my past__ and decide what the next course of action should be.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Retrospect"** means to look back on or review past events or situations. (पश्चातदृष्टि)
 
 
• **Example: **In retrospect, I realize that I made some mistakes in my previous job.
 
 
 
• **"Introspect"** means to examine one's own thoughts and feelings. (आत्मनिरीक्षण)
 
 
• **Example: **She decided to introspect and understand her own motivations better.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Prospect** (संभावना): The possibility or likelihood of some future event occurring.
 
 
• **Example:** The prospect of a promotion excited him.
 
 
 
• **Disrespect** (असम्मान): Lack of respect or courtesy.
 
 
• **Example: **His rude behavior showed a lot of disrespect.
